references.text: The departure of the children of Israel from Egypt, from Rameses to Sukkot, which is the first stage of the journey described in Numbers 33.
The Lord brought the children of Israel out of Egypt by their armies, the same expression used in Numbers 33:1.
Moses and Aaron were commanded to lead the children of Israel out of Egypt by their armies.
God promised to bring His armies, His people Israel, out of Egypt.
The children of Israel left Egypt with a raised hand, led by Moses.
Reference to the journeys and stopping places of the children of Israel, including the death of Aaron.
You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
God sent Moses, His servant, and Aaron whom He had chosen.
I brought you up from Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery, and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
Stephen speaks about Moses who led the people out of Egypt and performed signs and wonders.
Who was it that heard and yet rebelled? Was it not all those who left Egypt under Moses?
